_comment: Hero ability defs — Q/W/E/R per class. v2 foundation reads Mage (Blaise) only; Knight/Ranger ship in v2.1 per port spec Part 3. Mage values sourced VERBATIM from the React v1 repo: src/modules/village/hero/abilities/mage.ts (MAGE_ABILITIES). Field map: cd -> cooldown, mana -> manaCost, power -> damage, reach -> radius/range (strike/snare = acquire range, aoe/cleave/meteor = blast radius). The 'description' field is a concise 1-line effect blurb for the HUD ability-bar tooltip (WO-36 visual) — NOT canon React data; safe to re-author. Knight + Ranger sets are authored defensible placeholders — NOT yet in the React repo — and must be re-synced when v1 publishes data/abilities.json (port spec Part 8).

q.name: Arcane Bolt
q.description: Snap bolt at the nearest foe — 26 dmg, near-instant (0.5s).

w.name: Frost Nova
w.description: Freezing burst — 26 dmg + 1.4s freeze in a 5m ring (12s cd).

e.name: Healing Beacon
e.description: Heals the Heart for 48 in a 5m ring (16s cd).

r.name: Meteor Strike
r.description: Ultimate — 600 dmg meteor over a 9m blast (45s cd).

knight._comment: WO-494 Grok arena kit — gap-closer / formation-break / taunt / ult. Effects dash|knockback|taunt are NEW shapes resolved by HeroAbilities.ResolveEffect (raw-string branch); each is a damaging hit with positional CC. Cooldowns per WO-494 table (Leap 6 / Bash 9 / Call 12 / Radiant 40). Re-sync on v1 data/abilities.json publish.

q.name: Heroic Leap
q.description: Dash to a foe — 30 dmg, +bonus dmg & stun onto a Healer/Wizard (6s cd).

w.name: Shield Bash
w.description: Knockback cone + brief slow — 26 dmg; interrupts a Wizard cast, breaks Tank guard (9s cd).

e.name: Defender's Call
e.description: Taunt zone + temp shield — forces Tank/DPS onto you for 4s (12s cd).

r.name: Radiant Strike
r.description: Ultimate — charge then 220 dmg AoE nuke (9m); bonus on low Healer / interrupted Wizard (40s cd).

knight-skills._comment: FLAT pool of equippable Knight skill-tree abilities (heal+ranged spine). Each carries a unique 'id' so HeroLoadout equips it into a W/E/R slot via AbilityCatalog.FindById; the per-slot 'slot' key is the chooser's SUGGESTED slot only (the loadout decides the actual slot). Effects use only what HeroAbilities.ResolveEffect supports: strike / heal / snare / cleave / aoe. Referenced by the SKILL nodes (knight.t1*) in hero-talents.json via their 'abilityId'.

ranged-poke.description: Hurls a spear at the nearest foe — 28 dmg at range (1.2s cd).
